news.title: Trump announced a massive oil deal with Venezuela. Why it won't lower gas prices anytime soon
news.summary: The U.S. secured majority control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves. President Donald Trump announced Friday that the U.N. Security Council had approved a deal to sell the country's oil reserves to the United States.

news.title: FTC sues Amazon, accusing the e-commerce giant of misleading advertisers
news.summary: The FTC sued Amazon, alleging the company misled advertisers through a deceptive auctioning system. The FTC is seeking to have the case thrown out of court.

news.title: Bessent pushes back on Druckenmiller critique of bond intervention
news.summary: Bessent says he spoke with Druckenmiller after his op-ed was published. He says their conversation went "fine"

news.title: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
news.summary: The expectation had been for falling rates this year, but the war with Iran and its resulting rise in oil prices upended that. The expectation was that rates would fall this year.

news.title: Risk-reward outlook for stocks is getting worse as historically tough month kicks off, says Citadel
news.summary: The risk-reward of buying protection in the equity market looks compelling. The risk is that the market will fall back on its fears. But the risk is lower than the reward.

news.title: Here’s what’s worth streaming in September 2026 on Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max and more
news.summary: A slew of fan-favorite shows are returning for new seasons. Apple's 'Slow Horses' and Netflix's 'The Gentlemen' are among them.

news.title: My mother, 91, has dementia. Every bank says I need her signature to unlock her $100,000 stock certificate. What can I do?
news.summary: "These shares are the only assets in her estate without designated beneficiaries," her estate says. "They are her only assets," the estate adds.

news.title: My friend is charging everyone $80 to attend her 30th birthday party. She says it’s to cover the open bar. Is it rude to not go?
news.summary: “I think she would take it personally if I didn’t attend,” he says of his wife. “I’m not going to let her down.”

news.title: Tesla’s stock is leading S&P 500 gainers as investors prepare for a Cybercab launch
news.summary: The company is seemingly getting closer to rolling out a vehicle that comes without a steering wheel or pedals. The company is reportedly getting close to a release date for the vehicle.

news.title: Trump to meet with oil execs about cutting gas prices, as his Venezuelan SPR plan faces skepticism
news.summary: The president and his fellow Republicans look set to focus on affordability as the midterms near. The GOP is expected to make a big push on the issue in the coming weeks.
